text_block_list.text:
While on my way to the bookstore to search 
for training reference materials——

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Training to Build Stamina Without 
Strain", "Exercise Theory Without 
Burdening the Body"—— All right, this 
should be enough.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Could it be that you also came 
to buy training books?
choice_data_list: By "also", does that mean you are too?
By "also", does that mean you are as well?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because of my legs, I can't push 
myself too hard during training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So I need to make up for it with what I 
can do, and make up for lost time as fast 
as possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, surpassing "that light" would 
never——

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no, never mind. Well then, I'm 
heading back to the dorm to study! I hope 
you find some great books too, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*, of all days to forget something... 
I have to hurry back and continue reading 
that book——

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? The entrance door is 
closed...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Does this mean—— I'm locked inside?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Though if I contact someone at the dorm, 
they could probably call the staff for 
me... Since I'm here, maybe I'll enjoy the 
school at night for a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ The breeze feels so nice. The 
rooftop at night feels so fresh and 
magical somehow...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(So that's the rooftop hut where 
Brian-chan always takes naps, huh... 
...Maybe I'll climb up just for a bit?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (——Wait, huh...? No way, Brian-chan?!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(She's asleep... I see, so Brian-chan got 
locked in too, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...So this is the scenery you always look 
at. It's higher than usual, and the sky 
feels so close—— It makes my heart 
flutter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Still asleep. Brian-chan, could it be 
that you're planning to sleep until 
morning?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you keep sleeping like that, I might 
just show up in your dreams, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you, Brian-chan, I bet you're 
running in your dreams too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In a dream, I wouldn't have to worry about 
my legs, so I'd catch right up to you, and 
overtake you——

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...No, never mind! Doing it just in a 
dream would never satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far away you are, or how 
high the wall, I want to face you in 
reality, for real...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're loud.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian-chan, you're awake! Or... were 
you awake the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Did you hear my true feelings?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah... hey!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. Whether you heard me or 
not, my feelings aren't going to change—

Arriving at the academy early in the 
morning, I happened to spot Sakura Laurel 
and her friend.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... I'm still sleepy, but... we got 
to have quite the precious experience 
yesterday, didn't we, Brian-chan? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It was a pointless waste of energy.
choice_data_list: You two look pretty sleepy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Yes, to tell you the truth, 
we stayed up a little late last night, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I know. I won't say anything 
unnecessary!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So, as it stands... I'm sorry, but it's a 
secret. Well then, excuse us!
